implementation: native TypeScript SDK adapter; business BFF is supplied by the product

config.legacyMode: omitted or legacy preserves the original credential/SSE config
config.baseUrl: scoped same-origin relative path; max512; alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen path segments only
config.controller: public dispatch hint only; never authorization
config.streams: BFF v1 polling only; legacy SSE remains supported

transport.body: JSON POST only, no GET body
transport.customFetch: Trusted product adapter must honor AbortSignal and preserve request restrictions

status.ready: registered mount completes and bounded poll succeeds; observation, not admission/execution success
status.subscription: React observes actual runtime status; old runtime stops on config replacement

recovery.sameReceiptRetry: same effect/key/result/body within an attempt cycle
recovery.unknownAction: do not execute again merely because receipt is unknown
recovery.storage: per-tab optional recovery hints, not authorization; denied storage means in-memory boundary
recovery.activeHandler: already running JavaScript cannot be rolled back by stopping subsequent dispatch

bffRequirements: Current business login/Agent identity/Origin and CSRF
Ignore or reject browser-provided native secrets, role escalation and foreign coordinates
Per-request fresh resource-scoped native HostGrant and server-held credential/fence
Bound HTTP/body/response resources and current authorization without model/tool proxy through Go management
Return public facts only; server mapping and credentials need product-owned durable storage for production
